summary: suhaiseguranca.com.br Suhai Segurança Pessoal Brazilian personal security company founded in 1992 — one of the older, established firms in its niche. title: Netcore Unbxd
summary: netcoreunbxd.com Netcore Unbxd AI product-discovery platform for enterprise e-commerce: smart site search, 1:1 personalization, recommendations, visual intelligence ("Complete the Look"), catalog enrichment, and — its 2026 bet — a Shopping Agent (agentic commerce). summary: engineersireland.ie Engineers Ireland Ireland's national professional body for engineers, founded 1835 with a Royal Charter (1877) and statutory authority under a 1969 Act to award the "Chartered Engineer" (CEng) title. title: North Bridge Venture Partners
summary: northbridge.com North Bridge Venture Partners one of Boston's most storied venture capital firms, founded in 1994 by Bill Geary, Doug Kingsley, Ed Anderson, Mike Pehl, and Richard D'Amore — ~$3.5B under management across 8 funds, ~200+ investments, 100+ exits, and 14 unicorns. summary: songwooi.co.kr SONGWOOI (Song Woo Industrial Co., Ltd.,) South Korean manufacturer of automotive and industrial rubber hoses — intercooler/TCI, heater, fuel, CPF/DPF, and power steering lines — founded 1998 in Busan, HQ and plant in Yangsan since 2002. title: Petroleum Telcom Communications
summary: ptelcom.com Petroleum Telcom, Inc. (dba Telcom, Inc. / Telcom Communications) Southern California communications integrator founded in 1978 in Oxnard, CA — specializing in two-way radio for police/fire, microwave links, fiber optics, cell towers, and FCC licensing. title: Axle Logistics
summary: axlelogistics.com Axle Logistics non-asset freight brokerage founded in 2012 in Knoxville, Tennessee, by Drew Johnson and Jon Clay — two University of Tennessee grads who started with two people and one trucking software license.
